Business Overview:
[1]
Geekay Wires, part of Kandoi Group, is an ISO 9001:2015 certified manufacturer of niche-quality Galvanized Steel Wires, based in Hyderabad. Its products cater to diverse industries, including Power Transmission, Cable & Conductor, General Engineering, and Construction. The Company has established a strong customer base comprising PGCIL, State Transmission & Distribution Companies, electrical contractors, and infrastructure companies, with its products also gaining acceptance in overseas markets.
